name: float-negative-margin
note: A float with a negative right margin. The margin box (and therefore the line-box intrusion) shrinks to 64px, so text starts at x=74 — inside the float's border box — demonstrating that intrusion is governed by the margin box, not the border box.

harvest.html: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog and runs around the blue box whose right margin pulls the text close.

measureText.text: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog
whose right margin pulls the text close
